title: Vietnamese Grilled Pork Noodle Salad
description: A fusion of Vietnamese flavors with a vegan twist, featuring grilled portobello mushrooms and crispy noodles.
instructions: 2. Brush the portobello mushrooms with a little oil and season with salt and pepper.
3. Grill the mushrooms for 3-4 minutes per side, or until tender and slightly charred.
4. In a large bowl, combine the cooked noodles, sliced cucumber, grated carrots, and pickled carrots and daikon.
5. In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice and fish-free sauce.
6. Add the grilled mushrooms to the bowl and toss to combine with the sauce.
7. Sprinkle with chopped cilantro and serve immediately.
8. Garnish with additional cilantro and lime wedges, if desired.
